reviewer: Claude figure and section-text comparison at reduced size; not a radiologist review
method: Article sections that name an unbound left or right structure: 118 section figures were looked at with the sentence that names the structure. A figure was accepted only where it shows or marks the structure the sentence names.

side_values.caption_states_side: the quoted sentence states this side
side_values.side_not_stated: the sentence states no side; bound on the mirror-image assumption

rejection_reasons: CT with PET or histology in one composite
the sentence names the structure in general and the figure does not mark it
lung lobes, heart chambers, renal veins and venae cavae named without a side, which are not mirror images
a finding rather than a structure
